definitions: A cocktail with ingredients including orange juice and cream.

blocks.text: Dreamsicle is the fourth studio album from American singer and songwriter Maren Morris. It was released on May 9, 2025, by Columbia Records. The album was preceded by the release of an extended play titled Intermission (2024) and spawned two singles: "Carry Me Through" and "Bed No Breakfast"; "Be a Bitch" was released as the single from the album's deluxe edition.
Popsicle is a Good Humor-Breyers brand of ice pop consisting of flavored, colored ice on a stick.

images.alt: Fudgicle advertisement from 1938. Popsicle brands sponsored the Popeye radio show in 1938–1939.
